name: transformers-daily-benchmarks
description: An internal Hugging Face suite used for daily automated benchmarking of transformer models and library changes. It aggregates multiple small tests (e.g., classification, generation, and LM metrics) to detect regressions and monitor performance across common tasks. The suite is primarily intended for CI/regression testing rather than public model-ranking.
reputation: An internal Hugging Face CI benchmarking collection widely used within the organization for regression testing but not a standard public leaderboard.
